goal: Hint-first learning mode in backend/routers/history_tutor.py and frontend/src/app/dai-noi/ai/page.tsx

features_delivered: Hint-first learning mode: In backend/routers/history_tutor.py and backend/services/history_tutor.py, added build_socratic_hint_answer which provides progressive Socratic hints and guided observation steps without prematurely revealing the direct factual resolution unless explicitly requested (reveal_answer=True)

Pedagogical observation & primary source guidance: Socratic questions instruct students to observe relief carvings, layers, inscriptions, and symbols on relics (Cửu Đỉnh motifs) or architectural elements (Đại Nội monuments), guiding them to consult official court chronicles (Đại Nam Thực Lục, Khâm Định Đại Nam Hội Điển Sự Lệ) before concluding

Citation provenance inspection: Added GET /api/v1/history/tutor/citations/{source_id}/provenance and GET /api/v1/history/tutor/provenance/{source_id} endpoints returning exact primary source references (Title, Author, Volume, Chapter, Page, Folio, Locator, Archive URL, Rights Status, Verification Status) along with canonical SHA-256 provenance hashes

Negative abuse defense: Inspecting non-existent or fabricated source IDs raises HTTP 404 (SOURCE_NOT_FOUND); submitting forged or tampered provenance hashes raises HTTP 422 (PROVENANCE_HASH_MISMATCH); disputed claims cannot claim settled authority (su_lieu_xac_thuc) and are strictly flagged as dang_khao_cuu

Frontend UI integration: In frontend/src/app/dai-noi/ai/page.tsx, added interactive learning mode toggle ('Gợi mở (Hint-first)' vs 'Trực tiếp'), Socratic observation cards (Step 1: Observation, Step 2: Source lookup, Step 3: Socratic question), 'Mở đáp án chi tiết' reveal control, and interactive Provenance Inspection modal dialog displaying verified source metadata and SHA-256 integrity signatures
